<script>
    // Prevent search box from closing when clicking inside

    function openSearch() {
        if (searchBox) {

        searchBox.classList.remove('active');

        document.body.style.overflow = '';
        searchInput.value = '';
        toggleClearButton();
        if (searchResultsDiv) {
            searchResultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
        }
        // TCC scope search: reset to the free company default on close, so a reopen starts fresh (like the homepage)
        var _tccScope = document.getElementById('tccSearchScope');
        if (_tccScope) _tccScope.value = 'company';
        if (searchInput) searchInput.placeholder = 'Search any Indian company or CIN…';
        var _tccLock = document.getElementById('tccSearchLock');
        if (_tccLock) _tccLock.hidden = true;
    }

    if (searchBox) {
        searchBox.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
        });
    }

    if (searchBtn) {
        searchBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();

    }

    if (closeBtn) {
        closeBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();

        });

    if (overlay) {
        overlay.addEventListener('click', closeSearch);
    }

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && searchBox && searchBox.classList.contains('active')) {
            closeSearch();

    function toggleClearButton() {
        if (clearBtn) {
            if (searchInput && searchInput.value.trim() !== '') {
                clearBtn.style.display = 'flex';
            } else {
                clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
            }
        }
    }

    function toggleSearchResults() {
        if (searchResultsDiv) {
            if (searchInput && searchInput.value.trim().length === 0) {
                searchResultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
                searchBox.classList.remove('has-results');

    // TCC scope search: true when a premium scope is active — the native dropdown machinery below must

    function tccIsPremiumScope() {
        var s = document.getElementById('tccSearchScope');
        return !!(s && (s.value === 'people' || s.value === 'brand' || s.value === 'website'));
    }

    function checkSearchResultsVisibility() {
        if (tccIsPremiumScope()) {
            if (searchResultsDiv) searchResultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
            if (searchBox) searchBox.classList.remove('has-results');
            return;
        }
        if (searchResultsDiv) {
            const isVisible = searchResultsDiv.style.display !== 'none' &&
                             window.getComputedStyle(searchResultsDiv).display !== 'none';
            if (isVisible && searchInput && searchInput.value.trim().length > 2) {
                searchBox.classList.add('has-results');
            } else {
                searchBox.classList.remove('has-results');
            }
        }
    }

    if (searchResultsDiv) {
        const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
            mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
                if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'style') {
                    checkSearchResultsVisibility();
                }
            });
        });
        observer.observe(searchResultsDiv, {
            attributes: true,
            attributeFilter: ['style']
        });
        setInterval(function() {
            if (searchBox && searchBox.classList.contains('active')) {
                checkSearchResultsVisibility();
            }
        }, 300);
    }

    if (searchInput) {
        searchInput.addEventListener('focus', function() {
            if (searchInput.value.trim().length === 0 && searchResultsDiv) {
                searchResultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
                searchBox.classList.remove('has-results');
            }
        });

        if (clearBtn) {
            searchInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
                toggleClearButton();
                toggleSearchResults();
                setTimeout(checkSearchResultsVisibility, 250);
            });

            clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.stopPropagation();
                searchInput.value = '';

                toggleClearButton();

                if (searchBox) {
                    searchBox.classList.remove('has-results');

                var _tccLock = document.getElementById('tccSearchLock');

        // Ensure search results dropdown shows when typing (Home9.js handles the actual search)
        if (searchInput) {
            // Monitor for search results being populated by Home9.js
            if (searchResultsDiv) {
                var resultObserver = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
                    mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {

                            // Results were added by Home9.js — but never re-show over the premium lock

                                searchResultsDiv.style.display = 'block';

    // TCC scope search (header): BEGIN — premium teaser-lock, self-contained & revertible

        var input = document.getElementById('txtSearchGlobal');
        var sel = document.getElementById('tccSearchScope');

        var lockTitle = document.getElementById('tccLockTitle');
        var form = input ? input.closest('form') : null;
        var dropdown = document.getElementById('ul_CompanyListGlobal');
        if (!input || !sel || !lock) return;

        var PREMIUM = { people: 1, brand: 1, website: 1 };
        var PLACE = {
            company: 'Search any Indian company or CIN…',
            people: 'Search directors & people (Premium)',
            brand: 'Search brands worldwide (Premium)',

        };
        var LOCKTTL = {
            people: 'People & director search is a premium feature',

        function scope() { return sel.value; }
        function isPrem() { return !!PREMIUM[scope()]; }

        function showLock() {
            if (lockTitle) lockTitle.textContent = LOCKTTL[scope()] || 'This is a premium feature';

        function hideLock() { lock.hidden = true; }

        // ---- Fast company typeahead via the stored-proc endpoint /api/search/global

        var tccTimer = null, tccSeq = 0;

        }
        function tccClearLists() {

                var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.innerHTML = '';
            });
        }
        function tccHideDropdown() { if (dropdown) dropdown.style.display = 'none'; }

                .then(function (res) { if (seq !== tccSeq || isPrem()) return; tccRenderCompanies((res && res.data) || []); })
                .catch(function () { });
        }
        // Enter / submit: open the top result if we have one, else the full results page.
        function tccGoSearch() {
            var q = input.value.trim();
            if (!q) return;

            if (first) { first.click(); return; }
            window.location.href = '/search/' + q.replace(/[^\w\s]/gi, '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, '-').toLowerCase();

        // Capture phase runs BEFORE Home9.js's bubbling keyup/keypress, so we own the search box:
        // premium scopes show the lock; the free Companies scope uses the fast endpoint above.
        input.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) {
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
            if (isPrem()) { showLock(); return; }

            if (tccTimer) clearTimeout(tccTimer);
            if (input.value.trim().length < 3) { tccHideDropdown(); return; }
            tccTimer = setTimeout(tccRunCompanySearch, 200);
        }, true);
        input.addEventListener('keypress', function (e) {

    const mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobile-menu');

    const menuBtn = document.getElementById('mobile-menu-btn');
    const hamburgerIcon = document.getElementById('icon-hamburger');
    const closeIcon = document.getElementById('icon-close');

    let isMenuOpen = false;

    function toggleMobileMenu() {
        if (!isMenuOpen) {
            // OPEN MENU
            mobileMenu.style.left = '0';
            mobileoverlay.classList.add('active');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

            hamburgerIcon.style.display = 'none';
            closeIcon.style.display = 'block';

            isMenuOpen = true;
        } else {
            // CLOSE MENU
            mobileMenu.style.left = '-100%';
            mobileoverlay.classList.remove('active');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';

            closeIcon.style.display = 'none';
            hamburgerIcon.style.display = 'block';

            // Close submenus
            document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-submenu').forEach(submenu => {
                submenu.classList.remove('active');
                submenu.style.display = 'none';
            });
            document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu-toggle').forEach(toggle => {
                toggle.classList.remove('active');
            });

            isMenuOpen = false;
        }
    }

    menuBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleMobileMenu);
    mobileoverlay.addEventListener('click', toggleMobileMenu);

    // Mobile submenu toggle functionality
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const menuToggles = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu-toggle');
        
        menuToggles.forEach(toggle => {
            toggle.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                
                const targetId = this.getAttribute('data-target');
                const submenu = document.getElementById(targetId);
                
                if (submenu) {
                    const isActive = submenu.classList.contains('active');
                    
                    // Close all other submenus
                    document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-submenu').forEach(menu => {
                        if (menu.id !== targetId) {
                            menu.classList.remove('active');
                            menu.style.display = 'none';
                        }
                    });
                    
                    // Remove active class from all toggles except current
                    document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu-toggle').forEach(btn => {
                        if (btn !== this) {
                            btn.classList.remove('active');
                        }
                    });
                    
                    // Toggle current submenu
                    if (isActive) {
                        submenu.classList.remove('active');
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            submenu.style.display = 'none';
                        }, 300); // Wait for animation to complete
                        this.classList.remove('active');
                    } else {
                        submenu.style.display = 'block';
                        // Force reflow to ensure display is applied before adding active class
                        submenu.offsetHeight;
                        submenu.classList.add('active');
                        this.classList.add('active');
                    }
                }
            });
        });
    });
</script>

    function gotoMsmePage(enterprise_name, serial) {

                                    $(document).on("click", function () {
                                        closeMenu();
                                    });

                                    $(".menu-overlay").on("click", function () {
                                        closeMenu();
                                    });

                                    function closeMenu() {
                                        $(".headernav-dropdown").removeClass("active");
                                        $(".menu-overlay").removeClass("active");
                                        $(".tagglemenu-bar")
                                            .removeClass("open")
                                            .attr("aria-expanded", "false");
                                    }
